attributes.title: 2027 Summer Break Away & Annual Assembly
attributes.series: SCAFP Summer Break Away & Annual Assembly
attributes.organizer: South Carolina Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
South Carolina's family medicine academy returns to the Sonesta Resort on Hilton Head Island for its 2027 Summer Break Away and Annual Assembly, June 3 to 6. The meeting is open to family physicians, residents and other primary care clinicians, including those who practice outside South Carolina.

Residents present their work on Friday and Saturday, June 4 and 5. The academy says CME is offered but had not posted a credit total, fees or a schedule when we checked. SCAFP holds a discounted room block at the resort and says reservations open at the start of 2027.
